desc:
Overnight a storm rolled in, the town has been covered in sticks!
Will you clean all the sticks in time before the next storm?

How to play:
🌲 Clean all the sticks before the timer runs out!
🌟 Buy and upgrade tools to help you clean up faster!
🚪 Unlock new areas of the map as you go!
🤫 Clean it all to unlock the SECRET ENDING!

👍 Like the game & join the group for rewards!

Use code 100KVISITS for 200 gems 💎
Use code HALLOWEEN for 10 pumpkins 🎃 [Event Currency]

Tags : Sticks, Cozy, Clean, Cleanup, Asmr, Co-Op, Cleaning, Adventure, Teamwork, Teams, Story, Simulator, Pickup, Collect
